title: brig v0.3.0 Release Gate
headline: Every blocker from run 1 passes on the final main
summary: Two stress runs against brig main on a SIP-enabled Mac and two Ubuntu 24.04 hosts, and a delta pass on the final main. Run 1 found seven release blockers. After their fixes, run 2 passes all of them except the Homebrew tap check, which waits on hull#88.

verdict.label: Not tagged yet
verdict.text: No release blocker fails on 3e5ae98, and the delta pass found no regression. The tag waits on bundle rc10, which carries the --cpus fix.

runs.label: Run 1
runs.note: Before the fixes: brig 4ce5eee with bundle rc8. It needed workarounds for the HOME bug to get through the plan.

runs.label: Run 2
runs.note: After #343, #344, #345, #352 and bundle rc9. No workarounds.

runs.label: Delta
runs.note: The final main: adds #342 (network posture), #341 (brig shell removed) and the rc9 pin (#356).

hosts.label: macOS 26.5, SIP on
hosts.detail: arm64, 18 cores, 48 GB. Homebrew brig@main and hull@main, hvi backend.

hosts.label: Ubuntu 24.04, host A
hosts.detail: amd64, 16 CPUs, 13 GB. Rootless user install. Run 2: fresh install.

hosts.label: Ubuntu 24.04, host B
hosts.detail: amd64, 14 CPUs, 30 GB, shared with other work. Rootless user install. Run 2: upgrade from rc8.

blockers.name: The guest HOME reached the runtime
blockers.detail: brig put the guest's HOME into the runtime's own environment. hull then looked for its store under /root, and rootless nerdctl for /root/.docker/config.json.

mac.note: Every boot failed: mkdir /root: read-only file system.

lnx-a.note: Every image pull failed with EACCES on /root/.docker/config.json.

lnx-b.note: Same pull failure. Passed only with a DOCKER_CONFIG workaround.

mac.note: All six profiles boot with no wrapper. hull's store stays in ~/.hull.

lnx-a.note: ubuntu:latest removed, re-pulled and booted in 6.43 s.

lnx-b.note: debian:bookworm-slim pulled and booted in 5.83 s.

mac.note: All six profiles boot through Homebrew 3e5ae98, no wrapper.

blockers.name: Short guest commands lost their output
blockers.detail: urunc's in-guest agent reported a command's exit before its output was drained, so a short command could come back empty with exit 0.

lnx-a.note: Empty output: raw exec 15/100, exec -it 6/100, brig sh 12/100.

lnx-b.note: Not counted per path on this host.

mac.note: Linux only. The macOS path gave 100/100.

blockers.name: claude-code refused healthy sandboxes
blockers.detail: brig reads a few answers from the guest before it hands claude-code a credential. A lost answer read as a .claude mount that was not ephemeral, so brig refused.

lnx-a.note: 0 of 30 boots refused, plus 0 of 20 sequential.

lnx-b.note: 0 of 30 boots refused, plus 0 of 20 sequential.

blockers.name: A second rootless user took the first one's device grant
blockers.detail: Every user's setup wrote one shared udev rule, so the last user to run it held the grant, and every re-run asked for sudo.

lnx-a.note: One shared 99-brig-kvm.rules; re-runs always wanted sudo.

lnx-b.note: One shared 99-brig-kvm.rules; re-runs always wanted sudo.

lnx-a.note: Fresh install and brig-ctl rootless: no sudo call, no rule file changed.

lnx-b.note: Upgrade and brig-ctl rootless: 0 sudo calls, both rule hashes unchanged.

blockers.name: A no-sudo user install did not stop cleanly
blockers.detail: A user without sudo rights and without the one-time host preparation got a half-done install.

lnx-a.note: Unpacked the bundle, then prompted for a sudo password it could not read.

lnx-b.note: Unpacked the bundle, then failed: sudo needs a password.
Stopped after 7.8 s with one root block. The bundle was not downloaded.

blockers.name: A quarantined brig@main hung over SSH
blockers.detail: An ad-hoc signed channel build waited for a Gatekeeper prompt that a headless session cannot show.

mac.note: Notarized build: the first run printed at once.
First brig version in 0.35 s. spctl: Notarized Developer ID.
Quarantined first run printed in 0.32 s. spctl: Notarized Developer ID.

blockers.name: Homebrew 7 rejects the tap
blockers.detail: The tap's hull@main.rb has no URL for Intel Macs and no Linux stanza, so brew readall, and a re-tap of a trusted tap, fail for the whole tap.

mac.note: brew readall brig-sh/brig fails on hull@main.rb.
Still fails, as expected until hull#88 merges.

findings.title: The guest HOME reached the runtime
findings.detail: Every macOS boot and every rootless Linux image pull failed.

findings.title: Short guest commands lost their output
findings.detail: Fixed in bundle rc9, which brig's install.sh now pins.

findings.title: claude-code refused healthy sandboxes
findings.detail: Gone with rc9's exec fix. #354 adds a retry on top.

findings.title: Homebrew 7 rejects the tap's hull@main.rb
findings.detail: The channel cask is rendered with a top-level URL and depends_on :macos.

findings.title: A second rootless user took the first one's device grant
A no-sudo user install did not stop cleanly
findings.detail: It now stops before the download and prints one root block.

findings.title: --cpus has no effect on Linux
findings.detail: urunc used its default_vcpus (1) and never read the container's CPU limit. urunc 74dd0cc sizes the guest from it; bundle rc10 will carry it.

findings.title: brig-ctl uninstall leaves an image store the user cannot delete
findings.detail: About 11 GB under ~/.local/share/containerd stays behind, owned by subuids. A later install silently reuses it.

findings.title: A published port hangs for about 30 s after a restart
findings.detail: On macOS the guest gets a new MAC on every boot but keeps its IP, so the gateway dials a stale entry.

findings.title: Re-running brig-ctl rootless restarts containerd
findings.detail: Running sandboxes drop, and the next brig sh boots a new one.

findings.title: "Nothing was downloaded" is not quite true
findings.detail: brig's installer fetches cosign and the brig tarball before the bundle installer stops; ~/.sigstore stays.

findings.title: brig stop keeps a published host port on rootless Linux
findings.detail: Documented in #350; the port is freed on rm.

findings.title: brig <verb> --help exits 2
findings.detail: Top-level verbs refuse --help and -h as unknown flags.

findings.title: Publishing accepts a sandbox that does not exist
findings.detail: Failed first boots also leave entries in slug-claims.json.

findings.title: claude-desktop over SSH did not become ready
findings.detail: Timed out after 86.7 s in run 2; run 1 booted it. To investigate.

findings.title: A guest home outlives a sandbox removed outside brig
findings.detail: After hull rm and a brig ls prune, the home stays until that ref's next run. A refused vz run also leaves a slug claim.

open.title: Delta pass on brig main 3e5ae98
open.detail: Passed on macOS and host A with no regression: #342's postures on hvi and nerdctl, #341's brig shell removal, a forced pull, 100/100 exec, every profile.

open.title: Bundle rc10 with the --cpus fix
open.detail: urunc 74dd0cc is on the combined branch and bundle #11's CI is green. A live nproc check runs next, then the tag and brig's install.sh pin.

open.title: hull#88, the Homebrew 7 tap fix
open.detail: Ready for review. The tap check stays red until it merges.

open.title: Scheduled real-runtime tests
open.detail: A canary on every channel publish and a nightly run, rendering this same page.
